versions.objective: REGISTRY OF OCCUPATIONAL EXPOSURE TO CJD AND OTHER TRANSMISSIBLE SPONGIFORM ENCEPHALOPATHIES (TSEs) IN HEALTHCARE AND LABORATORY WORKERSTo standardise reporting and to establish a central database of occupational exposure to CJD and other TSEs in healthcare and laboratory workers.To provide long-term follow-up for public health monitoring of the risk of CJD in healthcare and laboratory workers who have reported occupational exposures to CJD and other TSEs. This public health register will help develop guidance for healthcare and laboratory workers.
